# dasl-testing fixtures

These CBOR test fixtures are copied, unchanged, from:

https://github.com/hyphacoop/dasl-testing/tree/a747efb/fixtures/cbor

(commit a747efb, 2026-11-09).

They are under the MIT License — see the LICENSE file in this directory.

Each fixture is tagged with the CBOR profile(s) it applies to.
This package's tests apply the fixtures tagged "basic", "dag-cbor", or "dasl-cid" —
which are the rules DRISL follows.
